scenes.text: I've paused your auth-service session. I need one decision from you: where should login sessions live?
Option one, Redis. Sessions sit in memory, so lookups are very fast, and each one has a timer, so expired logins clean themselves up. The catch: one more service to run.
Option two, Postgres. It's already in your stack, and sessions survive a restart. The catch: under heavy load, it's slower.
Both are solid. Tap your answer below, and I'll carry on with it.
